title: Emmy Noether: Modern LaTeX Drafts and English Translation Working Drafts
version: 2026-06-03 Noether record: Spanish and Japanese through Paper 18 complete
description:
Dedicated Emmy Noether record for the Modern LaTeX Editions of Mathematics Manuscripts project. The top-level PDFs expose source-checkable German modern LaTeX, English high-fidelity translations, and current multilingual translation pilots.

Status at a glance. Numbered-paper German/English stream: Papers 1-43 complete and audited. Multilingual stream: Spanish/Japanese cumulative readers are complete through Paper 18; Paper 01 French and complete Paper 02 French pilots are also included. Source/artifact preservation: TeX, source-scan witnesses, audit notes, build logs, render checks, and glossary/methodology deltas are preserved in ZIP artifacts.

Latest update. Adds Spanish and Japanese cumulative readers through Paper 18 complete, standalone Paper 17 sections 10-12 plus Paper 18 Spanish/Japanese readers, and the 85 Noether source/witness ZIP for the Paper 18 multilingual continuation.
notes: Latest update adds Spanish/Japanese cumulative readers through Paper 18 and a compact source/witness ZIP for the Paper 18 multilingual continuation.
